offerings.name: Google Search API (SERP API)
offerings.pricing: Top-up credits model, no monthly subscriptions: Starter $50 (50k credits, $1.00/1k); Standard $375 (500k credits, $0.75/1k); Scale $1250 (2.5M credits, $0.50/1k); Ultimate $3750 (12.5M credits, $0.30/1k). * Excluding sales tax/VAT/GST
offerings.price_basis: Starter 档（$50 买 50k credits，$1.00/1k queries）；批量加购更高档降至 $0.75/1k、$0.50/1k、$0.30/1k
offerings.free_quota: Get 2,500 free queries / No credit card required
offerings.output_type: JSON 结构化搜索结果（knowledgeGraph、organic、peopleAlsoAsk、relatedSearches 等）
offerings.note: 支持 Search/Images/News/Maps/Places/Videos/Shopping/Scholar/Patents/Autocomplete；结果含 link/googleUrl 等来源链接；实时查询不缓存；1-2 秒返回；50-300 QPS；credits 有效期 6 个月；可指定国家与语言
